results.summary: EnergyPathways plc provided a company update on the MESH energy storage hub project, detailing progress across three elements: Long Duration Energy Storage (LDES), Strategic Natural Gas and Hydrogen Storage, and Hydrogen Industries. The LDES project received designation as a project of 'National Significance' by the UK Government in September 2025, enabling streamlined permitting processes. The announcement describes project specifications, strategic value, and underlying energy security challenges the project addresses. However, no financial results, revenue, profit figures, or performance metrics are provided, and no explicit comparison to market expectations, guidance, or forecasts is made. This is a project update, not an earnings announcement or guidance statement.

results.headline: Update on Financing
results.key_quote: The Board of Directors of the Company consider that, while the ISP review has created uncertainty, based on current information there remains a reasonable prospect of ultimately receiving the ISP approval and concluding the Financing during 2026.
results.summary: Beowulf Mining provides a financing update with no performance metrics or earnings guidance discussed. The announcement focuses on regulatory delays from the Swedish Inspectorate of Strategic Products (ISP) reviewing a proposed strategic investment, with the primary Bacchus Capital investment unable to extend its long-stop date beyond 30 September 2026. The company has secured interim funding of approximately £110,000 and cost reduction measures to operate until end of 2026, pending ISP approval. There is no comparison of operational or financial performance to any stated expectations, making this a pure corporate update without performance classification.

results.headline: Final Results and CEO Succession
results.key_quote: The Group delivered revenues of £50.0 million for the Period representing underlying growth of 16.0% on a proforma basis versus the previous seventeen months to 31 May 2025, primarily driven by volume.
results.summary: Venture Life Group reported continuing operations revenue of £50.0 million with 16.0% underlying proforma growth, driven by volume. Gross profit increased to £22.3 million but gross margin declined slightly to 44.6%. Adjusted EBITDA increased to £7.9 million but adjusted EBITDA margin declined to 15.7%, reflecting temporary de-leveraging of operating costs following divestitures. Operating profit before exceptional items decreased to £1.5 million. The company successfully transformed to a pure-play consumer healthcare business through strategic divestitures and acquired FemiClear and CUROXEN brands post-period end. No explicit comparison to market or analyst expectations is provided in the announcement. Results are presented as operational achievements without stated guidance upgrades or explicit performance versus expectations messaging.

results.headline: Audited results for the year ended 31 March 2026
results.key_quote: Order intake in September (including a few orders drifting into the first few days of October) will be towards the upper end of the communicated £1.1-1.2m range, with MTE closing out the best month since its acquisition in May
results.summary: Time To ACT reported audited results with turnover of £2.42m (6% growth YoY) and significantly improved gross profit margin of 69% (vs 47% prior year). The company achieved an unqualified audit opinion with no going concern issues. CEO commentary indicates positive momentum with order intake expected at the upper end of the £1.1-1.2m communicated range in September, representing performance ahead of stated expectations. The company is described as moving positively on business outlook with hydrogen sector opportunities materializing.
metrics_ahead: Gross profit margin improved from 47% to 69%
Order intake towards upper end of communicated range
Positive shift in business momentum
Unqualified audit opinion with no going concern issues

results.headline: Preliminary Results
results.key_quote: Early Group trading in FY27 has seen a continuation of the momentum built in FY26, and with international macro GRC drivers providing a favourable backdrop, we are well positioned for continued growth and on track to achieve market expectations.
results.summary: Wilmington delivered strong revenue growth of 37% in ongoing revenues and adjusted EBITA growth of 33%, with eight of nine businesses growing. The Conversia acquisition has performed ahead of initial forecast. The company states it is 'on track to achieve market expectations' with early FY27 trading showing continuation of momentum. While the results show robust growth, the framing is somewhat cautious - the CEO states they are on track to meet expectations rather than explicitly stating they have beaten or materially exceeded them. The margin compression (PBT margin down 5ppt) and transition to net debt position provide some offsetting factors.
metrics_ahead: Ongoing revenue growth of 37%
Ongoing adjusted EBITA growth of 33%
Conversia acquisition performed ahead of initial forecast
Eight of nine ongoing businesses grew
Repeat revenue maintained at 80%

results.headline: Preliminary Results
results.key_quote: We continue to make good progress on costs as we track ahead of schedule, delivering c.£36 million of annualised cost savings in FY 2026 against a target of c.£25 million.
results.summary: Close Brothers delivered mixed results. Cost savings significantly exceeded target (£36m actual vs £25m target, tracking ahead of schedule), and loan book growth accelerated in H2. However, adjusted operating profit declined 17% year-on-year (£120.3m vs £144.3m), adjusted EPS fell 20% (47.5p vs 59.3p), and return on equity metrics declined. The company maintained its strategic guidance (5-10% loan growth target, double-digit returns by FY2028) but did not upgrade expectations. Capital ratios remained elevated at 14.1% (above the 12-13% medium-term target range).
metrics_ahead: Cost savings tracking ahead of schedule (£36m vs £25m target)
Loan book growth accelerated in final quarter
All divisions delivering growth in final quarter
Capital capacity to absorb Basel 3.1

results.headline: Replacement - Amitsoq Update
results.key_quote: The locked-cycle test yielded a concentrate grading 95.2% graphite, with an overall recovery of more than 90%.
results.summary: GreenRoc has announced positive results from processing test work on a graphite ore sample from the Amitsoq project in Greenland. Test work showed a graphite concentrate grading of 95.2% with recovery exceeding 90%. The company has selected GTK Mintec in Finland to process the full 20-tonne bulk sample, with results expected before end of 2026. A survey of historical underground workings has been completed. However, the announcement contains no comparison to market expectations, guidance targets, or analyst forecasts, and does not reference any prior expectations or guidance.

results.headline: Update on Liberation Bioindustries
results.key_quote: the previously announced target for completion of the Facility in Q4 2026 will not be met...a funding gap has been identified...construction progress at the site has slowed
results.summary: Liberation Bioindustries, a key portfolio company of Agronomics, has failed to secure external partners through a strategic review and now faces a significant funding shortfall. The company requires an additional ~$25 million and expects a six-month delay following funding, pushing the previously announced Q4 2026 completion target to an uncertain timeline in 2027. Construction progress has slowed pending additional financing. This represents a material setback from prior expectations, though management states the delay is not expected to materially impact net asset value.
